result.quote: “Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea in the third hour of the night.
result.reason: The commander ordered the specified troops to go to Caesarea and, in the next verse, ordered mounts for Paul so he could be taken safely to Felix. The key accurately combines these related arrangements. Shorter answers mentioning either the escort or the mounts would be incomplete rather than materially different. The edit preserves the source pair’s intended focus on the commander’s protective response.
